description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: SourceType=UPLOAD时必传，标识待上传 Skill 压缩包的 OSS 地址
description.en: The OSS URL of the Skill package to upload. This parameter is required when SourceType is set to UPLOAD.
The ID of the SkillSpace to which the Skill belongs.

description.zh: SourceType=COPY时必传，标识公共 Skill ID
description.en: The public Skill ID. This parameter is required when SourceType is set to COPY.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请先确认服务商在创建服务时开启变配功能并完成变配参数设置。
descriptions.en:
### Before you begin
Make sure that the service provider has enabled the Upgrade/Downgrade feature and completed the specification change parameter settings when creating the service.
